votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes of December 2, 2025
votes.description: The Council approved the work session meeting minutes from December 2, 2025 as part of the opening ceremony.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council Meeting (Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 256 East 300 South)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-MU to D-1 at 256 East 300 South, which would allow a 185-foot hotel development, and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council Meeting (Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 1073 South Navajo Street)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/5,000 to RMF-30 at 1073 South Navajo Street to allow additional for-sale homes, and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 15 of 2026, Text Amendment - Expiration of Land Use Approvals
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending Titles 20 and 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to expand the actions an applicant may take to prevent an approved land use application from expiring, clarifying compliance with the Utah Code requirement for reasonable diligence.

votes.motion: Reject the ordinance (Sugar House Hotel Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendments at approximately 2111 South 1300 East)
votes.description: The Council rejected the proposed ordinance that would have rezoned 2111 South 1300 East from MU-3 to MU-8 and amended the Sugar House Community Master Plan to allow a hotel adjacent to Sugar House Park, citing concerns about setting a precedent for expanding the business district beyond adopted community plan boundaries.

The Council approved the full consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for several street closure and zoning ordinances and approving the reappointment of Kathryn Floor to the Public Utilities Advisory Committee through January 21, 2030.
